verdicts.reason: A keeps the can inside its circle and wraps the headline cleanly, but the right cluster is jammed: the body copy touches the top edge, and the CTA and badges are scattered (SUMMER ONLY sits orphaned below, off the grid), with tiny text throughout. B separates the can from its circle and reuses the empty circle as a backing for the SOLSTICE wordmark, which overflows it. Its headline breaks awkwardly ('Mint is / back'), and the body copy is squeezed into a narrow 7-line column of illegible text. B's stacked CTA and badges are tidier, but the brand imagery is mangled.
